name: Fine Mansion, Foyer
desc1: This expansive, square chamber has walls of a finely grained grey
desc2: wood, and the floors are a patterened black marble. Slightly
desc3: disturbing statues stand on short pedestals here, and odd portraits
desc4: hanging from the walls seem to stare at you with a life of their own.
desc5: Racks for hanging coats and cloaks stand by the door here, and an
desc6: ornate boot-rack sits to one side. A plush red carpet leads off down
desc7: a passage to the south, and the only other exit is through the door.
